title: E8 Artifact Regeneration Pipeline
architecture_upgrade: Records the exact regeneration DAG from root metadata to structure constants to Z3/bracket analyzers, turning the artifact blocker into an executable pipeline plan.
theorem: The E8 operation bridge has a finite regeneration order: root metadata must be built first, structure constants second, grading verification third, and coupling analyzers after that. No bracket-level claim is allowed until the preflight reaches the relevant ready state.
